topic: Producer-direct KV cache writes (wave/DecodeCopyFusion): extend the values planner to the model's real view chain, then decide on the full llvmpipe + M1 gate
history: 68e3bc76 added the producer-direct KV writes gated by MLX_OMARCHY_KV_DIRECT (default on). First llvmpipe model census (2026-09-10) showed the feature INERT: both env arms 321 dispatches/token with the merged pair present, because plan_values_window required a single Reshape while mlx-lm delivers the values rows as Reshape([1,1,n_kv,hd]) + Transpose({0,2,1,3}). Debug instrumentation (receipts/llvmpipe/kvd-dbg2-stderr.log) proved every pair classified keys_rope/none. 1f200940 extends the planner to walk the bounded view-only chain (Transpose/Reshape) and prove the layout: composed element strides from the row-contiguous sum must re-index without moving bytes and satisfy sum[head*head_dim + dim] for update element (head, dim) -- exactly the GEMV store order. Every chain view must have one consumer and becomes a window alias; any mismatch keeps the ordinary plan; the runtime abort unwind is unchanged.

decision: land on wave/DecodeCopyFusion: dispatches per decode token fall (273.0 -> 249.0 on the M1 instrument, 321 -> 297 on the llvmpipe chain census, SliceUpdatePairF16 24 -> 0 per decode token), decode improves repeatably (+1.96%/+2.10%/+2.43% medians, fork ahead in every pair), all 18 digest checks canonical, five test batteries green on llvmpipe and M1. Branch stays on wave/DecodeCopyFusion; merging to main is Main's call, not this receipt's.
